fieldDescription: Master toggle that enables or disables all live combat previews across tooltips and the Codex. Off leaves every tooltip and Codex page untouched and skips building the preview engine on load.
Shows a live combat preview in weapon and fighter wing tooltips. Off leaves every tooltip as the game draws it.
Shows a live combat preview above the description on weapon and fighter Codex pages in the campaign and on the title screen.
[BETA] Shows a live combat preview above the description on weapon and fighter Codex pages during combat. Experimental: running previews alongside a live battle may cause bugs or mod conflicts.
Plays the preview's weapon fire and impacts at your [sound effects volume]. Off keeps every preview silent.
Writes what the previews do to [starsector.log], for troubleshooting. Errors are always logged.
Waits before expanding the preview with a short static animation on tooltips and Codex pages. Off shows the preview immediately.
Seconds to wait on a tooltip or Codex page before expanding the preview (when [Add Delay] is enabled).

The ship your weapons fire at, stripped of weapons and fighters. In [point defense] previews it launches from every missile slot and fighter bay: [Drover] 4 small slots, 2 bays. [Condor] 1 medium slot, 2 bays. [Gemini] 1 medium slot, 1 bay.
How the dummy uses its shield. [Fluctuating] turns it on and off every [6 seconds].
In [point defense] previews, cycles what the dummy launches: missiles, wings, or both.
In [point defense] previews, cycles the dummy's missile: Harpoon, Swarmer, Annihilator, Reaper or Hammer.
In [point defense] previews, cycles the dummy's fighters: Broadsword, Talon or Wasp.
